name: Welcome After Registration
title: Welcome to MatchMate, {{firstName}}
message: Your account is ready. Complete your profile to get better matches.
pushBody: Hi {{firstName}}, complete your profile and start connecting.
emailBody:
Hello {{firstName}},

Thanks for registering on MatchMate. Complete your profile and verify your details to improve your match quality.

- MatchMate Team
smsBody: Welcome to MatchMate, {{firstName}}. Complete your profile to start getting better matches.

name: Email Verification OTP
title: Verify your email
message: Use code {{otp}} to verify your email. Expires in {{expiryMinutes}} minutes.
pushBody: Use OTP {{otp}} to verify your email.
emailBody:
Hello {{firstName}},

Use this OTP to verify your email: {{otp}}
This code expires in {{expiryMinutes}} minutes.

If you did not request this, please ignore this message.

name: Phone Verification OTP
title: Verify your phone number
message: Use code {{otp}} to verify your phone. Expires in {{expiryMinutes}} minutes.
smsBody: Your MatchMate phone verification OTP is {{otp}} ({{expiryMinutes}} min).

name: Profile Completion Reminder
title: Complete your profile
message: Your profile is {{completionPercent}}% complete. Add more details for better matches.
emailSubject: Complete your profile for better matches
emailBody:
Hi {{firstName}},

Your profile is {{completionPercent}}% complete. Add photos, bio, and preferences to improve visibility.
smsBody: Hi {{firstName}}, your profile is {{completionPercent}}% complete. Add details for better matches.

name: Interest Received
title: New interest from {{senderName}}
emailBody:
Hello {{firstName}},

Good news. {{senderName}} has shown interest in your profile. Open MatchMate to respond.
smsBody: {{senderName}} sent you an interest on MatchMate. Check the app.

name: Interest Accepted
title: {{receiverName}} accepted your interest
emailBody:
Hi {{firstName}},

{{receiverName}} accepted your interest. Start a conversation now.
smsBody: Great news. {{receiverName}} accepted your interest on MatchMate.

name: Profile View Alert
title: Your profile was viewed
emailBody:
Hi {{firstName}},

{{viewerName}} viewed your profile. Update your profile to increase responses.

name: New Match Found
title: You have a new match
message: You and {{matchName}} are a good match.
emailSubject: You have a new match on MatchMate
emailBody:
Hi {{firstName}},

You have a new match: {{matchName}}. Say hello and start a meaningful conversation.
smsBody: New match: {{matchName}} on MatchMate. Open the app to connect.

name: Message Received
title: New message from {{senderName}}
emailBody:
Hello {{firstName}},

{{senderName}} sent you a new message on MatchMate.

name: Password Reset OTP
title: Reset your password
message: Use OTP {{otp}} to reset your password. Expires in {{expiryMinutes}} minutes.
pushBody: Use OTP {{otp}} to reset your password.

name: Subscription Purchase Success
title: Subscription activated
emailBody:
Hi {{firstName}},

Your {{planName}} subscription is active until {{validTill}}. Enjoy premium features.
smsBody: Your MatchMate {{planName}} plan is active until {{validTill}}.

name: Subscription Expiry Reminder
title: Subscription expires in {{daysLeft}} days
message: Renew your {{planName}} plan to keep premium features.
emailBody:
Hello {{firstName}},

Your {{planName}} subscription expires in {{daysLeft}} days. Renew now to avoid interruption.
smsBody: Your {{planName}} plan expires in {{daysLeft}} days. Renew on MatchMate.

name: Report Status Updated
title: Report update
message: Your report for {{reportedUserName}} has been marked as {{status}}.
emailBody:
Hi {{firstName}},

The report you submitted for {{reportedUserName}} is now {{status}}. Thank you for helping keep MatchMate safe.

name: Weekly Match Digest
title: Your weekly match summary
message: You have {{newMatches}} new matches and {{newInterests}} new interests this week.
emailBody:
Hi {{firstName}},

This week: {{newMatches}} new matches, {{newInterests}} interests, and {{profileViews}} profile views.
